Method of Attack: Malicious code in setup.py that downloads and runs a Bash script to install cryptomining malware (Ubqminer or T-Rex GPU miner)
Attack Vector: Typosquatting on legitimate matplotlib package names in PyPI
Indicators of Compromise: setup.py file containing malicious code, download of aza2.sh script from GitHub, cryptominer Ubqminer or T-Rex miner running, replaced Kryptex wallet address for mining UBQ cryptocurrency
